why_best: Simultaneously inverting the background and text colors in place gives the key insight immediate weight and executive clarity for quick visual parsing.
why_bad: A progressive horizontal wipe across the phrase draws out the motion unnecessarily and feels like a casual hand-drawn marker rather than a crisp visual callout.
trap: A near-miss will accidentally slide or stretch the emphasis bar across the text line rather than transitioning the entire highlight block uniformly at once.
